title: "Appendix D: f-string Format Code Reference"

# Appendix D: f-string Format Code Reference

**Syntax:**
```python
f"{value:[fill][align][width][,_][.precision][type]}"
```

## 1. Type Conversion Specifiers

| Code | Meaning | Input Example | Specifier | Output String |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `d` | Decimal Integer | `42` | `{42:4d}` | `'  42'` |
| `f` | Fixed-point Float | `3.14159` | `{3.14159:.2f}` | `'3.14'` |
| `e` | Scientific Exponent (lower) | `0.000452` | `{0.000452:.2e}` | `'4.52e-04'` |
| `E` | Scientific Exponent (upper) | `0.000452` | `{0.000452:.2E}` | `'4.52E-04'` |
| `%` | Percentage | `0.852` | `{0.852:.1%}` | `'85.2%'` |
| `s` | String | `'data'` | `{'data':>8s}` | `'    data'` |
| `b` | Binary | `10` | `{10:08b}` | `'00001010'` |
| `x` | Hexadecimal | `255` | `{255:02x}` | `'ff'` |

## 2. Width, Alignment, and Padding

| Format Code | Effect | Output |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `{val:>10}` | Right-aligned in 10-char space | `'      3.14'` |
| `{val:<10}` | Left-aligned in 10-char space | `'3.14      '` |
| `{val:^10}` | Centered in 10-char space | `'   3.14   '` |
| `{count:05d}` | Zero-padded 5-digit integer | `'00042'` |
| `{num:12,d}` | Comma thousand separator | `'   1,000,000'` |
| `{1000000:_.2f}` | Underscore thousands separator | `'1_000_000.00'` |

## 3. Useful Debugging Shorthand (Python 3.8+)
Appending `=` prints the variable name along with its evaluated value:

```python
x = 25.4
y = 10.2
print(f"{x=}, {y=}, {x*y=:.2f}")
# Output: x=25.4, y=10.2, x*y=259.08
```
